title: Valid Palindrome
statement:
Given a string `s`, return `true` if it is a palindrome when you consider only letters and digits and ignore case, and `false` otherwise.

A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards.
constraints: s consists of printable ASCII characters

keyPoints.text: Skips characters that are not letters or digits and compares letters case-insensitively
Uses two pointers moving towards each other instead of building reversed copies
Handles the empty string and a string without letters or digits as palindromes

tests.name: Example 1
args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
tests.explanation: Ignoring punctuation and case it reads "amanaplanacanalpanama".
